scout.title: Culvert marked on the shift board
scout.copy: Dena Pike taps the chalk mark you made. “That’s where the water came through. I’ll show the next crew before they go down.”

help.title: Warning lamp relit
help.copy: Dena lights the warning lamp over Iona’s dispatch. “She said you waited till she was clear. You can still read every word.”

pass.title: Relief crew due at dawn
pass.copy: The duty board gives the relief crew’s usual time. The lane to the breakwater is still open.

scout.title: Lower tunnel marked
scout.copy: Wren Moss adds your lamp marks to the shift map. “There’s a way back out of the lower tunnel. Mark that bit twice.”

help.title: The lift crew is home
help.copy: A worker hangs the lamp in the stone shop window. Wren points it out to you. “Stones and Beyond will know that token when they see it.”

pass.title: Today’s lift hours
pass.copy: The keeper tacks up the next shift. The stone shop is open, with the shopkeeper’s hot cup set on the step.

scout.title: Survey plot circled
scout.copy: A student copies your mark onto the grove chart, then checks it against the tracks. “I can go out there after class.”

help.title: Notebook returned to the academy
help.copy: The field notebook is behind glass. A student buffs a thumbprint off the new author card. “We put her name back.”

pass.title: The academy’s survey timetable
pass.copy: The field case gives the time of the next class. There’s still a blank in the chart where the old grove should be.

scout.title: Thicket warning posted
scout.copy: Rook Alder draws the tracks beside the old bell mark. “I’m putting that sound on the patrol sheet. That way they’ll know it if they hear it.”

help.title: Shift warning acknowledged
help.copy: Your warning is clipped to the duty board. Rook taps the signature. “Good. Somebody knew where we’d gone for once.”

pass.title: Next warden shift
pass.copy: The duty desk has its ordinary patrol times. Someone has left the lane gate propped with a boot.

scout.title: Reed gap mapped
scout.copy: The keeper adds your gap in the reeds to a hand-drawn map. “You can see the planks from there even after the lights come on.”

help.title: Returned tags on display
help.copy: Edda Marr takes the returned enclosure tags out of a drawer. “Hang these where they can see them before they ask.”

pass.title: Safari check-in
pass.copy: A keeper checks the boardwalk list while somebody across the street opens the Game Corner for the day.

scout.title: Dispatcher's private note
scout.copy: Nera Vale puts your scrap of map inside her own. “It goes in here. I don’t want a crowd at the shelter.”

help.title: Emergency cabinet open
help.copy: Nera clips the accepted manifest to the open cabinet. She leaves the key in just long enough for the last worker to come through.

pass.title: Freight notice
pass.copy: The freight times are up on the board. Nera is adding the last departure to the paper in her hand, a minute at a time.

scout.title: Training call identified
scout.copy: The lookout puts your scrap on the other side of the relay glass. “I know that call. Check your lead before the next match.”

help.title: Emergency beacon lit
help.copy: Somebody on the high path answered the beacon. The lookout throws a dry coat over her shoulders and leaves it lit.

pass.title: Highcountry weather report
pass.copy: A forecast is tacked to the relay door. The person on duty has penciled in a time to come back out and look.

scout.title: A second lantern at the pool
scout.copy: The keeper sets a second lantern by the pool. “Someone described that face to me before. Same side of the water, too.”

help.title: The chapel steps are lit
help.copy: A traveler takes both steps in one go. “I could see where to put my feet from right across the water.”

pass.title: Chapel entrance
pass.copy: One lantern is lit at the usual door. You have to be on the first step to see the second.

scout.title: Victory Road register
scout.copy: Orin Beck puts the old register where you choose your lead. “You can keep it open while you think.”

help.title: Pass checked
help.copy: The League worker marks the pass clear in the log and leaves the radio on. “Somebody up there heard you.”

pass.title: League registration
pass.copy: The League clerk draws a chair up beside the route radio. The desk remains open.

listen.title: Gate-token sketch
listen.copy: The keeper puts the dented gate-token stamp beside a sketch of the matching bolt hole. The token still sits a little off-centre.

act.title: Survey line live
act.copy: The lift office shows Mara’s survey line live. Wait there and you can hear the two ticks between its signal and the lift’s.

listen.title: R-17 counterfoil
listen.copy: The case is locked. Through the glass you can make out R-17 and the signature on the counterfoil.

act.title: R-17 plate rubbing
act.copy: A rubbing lies by the R-17 press. The chipped ring left the same thin gap on both.

listen.title: Private duty-desk appointment
listen.copy: Mara’s slip asks to check the call number away from the duty board. The ranger is waiting to show it to you in person.

act.title: Redacted transfer copy
act.copy: The clerk put the two tags beside L-06 after their shift. They laid a strip of blank paper over their own initials.

listen.title: Signed Route 6 call log
listen.copy: The copy at the ranger booth still has Ivo’s request to stop the truck. The duty ranger signed in the margin because that was the space left.

act.title: Gatehouse weight duplicate
act.copy: The duplicate puts the gatehouse weight beside EMPTY. Someone has underlined the two entries at exactly the same height.

listen.title: Weigh-slip at Bay Nine
listen.copy: Nera slips the weigh-slip in beside the Bay Nine yard ledger. You can see the carbon through both pages.

act.title: A clean tackle box
act.copy: Mara’s empty tackle box is at the depot. A note tucked into the handle says the rescued Krabby has started eating.

listen.title: Private relay recording
listen.copy: You can hear Ivo say, “I won’t give them my name over a freight radio.” The sleeve directs you to the old relay. It has no public label.

act.title: Dry blanket at the relay
act.copy: The shelter crew stuffed a dry blanket in the cracked window. Below it, a lamp picks out the path they showed you.

listen.title: Ivo’s signed distress time
listen.copy: Ina keeps Ivo’s signed distress time in the drawer. The hikers’ names have been left off the public copy.

act.title: Coat drying below the chapel
act.copy: A hiker has laid their coat out along the chapel rail. “We could see the lookout’s light when we couldn’t see anything else.”

listen.title: Keeper statement accepted
listen.copy: Ina’s statement has a box for her permission and another for the clerk’s acceptance. Both are filled in.

act.title: Carbon impression filed
act.copy: The pressure mark on the carbon gives a different closure time. A cover sheet keeps the names on the original inside the file.

listen.title: Sealed certified copy
listen.copy: The sealed copy is waiting at the Crucible service entrance. The list of people allowed to open it stops with the people who signed.

act.title: The inquiry address
act.copy: The board gives the case number and the address where the inquiry will be answered. The next line is blank.

listen.title: Ivo’s private note
listen.copy: Ivo approved a copy for your own record. There’s room for other names when their owners decide to put them there.

act.title: Public correction filed
act.copy: The signed correction went on the public board under Ivo’s name. The other witnesses are unnamed.

rocket.title: A truck without a logo
rocket.copy: At the truck stop, three names from the ledger have gone onto the noticeboard. There’s still a clean rectangle on the truck door.

magma.title: Water carried up the hill
magma.copy: The high houses get first pick of buckets from the well. A child holds her stuffed Vulpix above the splash line.

aqua.title: Swimming beside the repaired quay
aqua.copy: A child practises the same stroke beside the new sandbags. The parent who used to wait on the quay is in the water this time.

galactic.title: Two clocks disagree
galactic.copy: The shrine keeper remembers asking the time. Across the square, a neighbor holds a fence board still while the other finds the nail.

plasma.title: Space beside the fire
plasma.copy: At the rest stop your partner chooses the space by your feet. You slide the pack out of the way.

flare.title: A redacted list
flare.copy: The notice asks who authorized the lists. The names of those affected have been folded away from anyone passing in the street.

skull.title: Check-in at the old house
skull.copy: The kitchen list has two blank spaces. Plumeria takes a coat off a hook and puts it on before Guzma has found the car keys.

yell.title: The show poster came down
yell.copy: The venue posts its regular hours in the pale rectangle left by Marnie’s tour poster.

macroCosmos.title: Fresh paint, old contract
macroCosmos.copy: The company number is new. The first clause under the fresh paint is the one you remember.

star.title: The kitchen rota
star.copy: On the kitchen rota, a student ticks the second helping as well as the first. It’s the way they know what to cook tomorrow.

cubone.title: A stone set back
cubone.copy: The stone you set back is still on top. Somebody has cleared the grass round the next one.

variants.accepted: The loose stone is back where it belongs. The grandmother’s letter lies below the unfinished cairn.
variants.declined: The loose stone is back where it belongs. There’s still an empty space at the end of the line.

yamask.title: A mask in the window
yamask.copy: The mask in the window has been turned to face the light. The shopkeeper still hasn’t given it a name.

hypno.title: A return notice
hypno.copy: Someone added FOUND to the old poster. There’s no space on the new one for questions about where she’s been.

phantump.title: The list stops
phantump.copy: The list still ends where it ended yesterday. Someone has taken the shoe off the path.

mimikyu.title: A seam repaired
mimikyu.copy: The repaired seam shows when you stand close to the window. Whoever set out the costume turned that side to the light.

variants.seen: The repaired seam faces the light. The mark from the old price tag is still there.
variants.away: The glass reflects the street instead of the costume. It’s a little farther back. The seam has been repaired.

drifloon.title: Wind report on the post
drifloon.copy: The lookout put both names on the shelter report. They came in together.

parasect.title: A question at the empty chair
parasect.copy: The new clerk agrees to look up the missing trainer’s last shift. The chair beside him is empty.

mewtwo.title: A repaired lab seal
mewtwo.copy: A fresh dated seal covers the door. You can still read the file number through the glass.
